source: Actual Granum dashboard with aerial-mini; no mocked metrics or API responses.

cues.text: The project overview connects working data, dataset versions and model runs.
Images is the working collection. Filtering changes the view, not membership in a dataset version.
Open Stats to inspect class imbalance and object sizes before choosing a training recipe.
Patches shows individual labelled objects. Use it to compare label consistency; inspect the full image before changing a label.
Health flags measurable dataset risks. A clean report is not proof that every label is correct.
